body.summary: Authentication bypass Supervisor API
body.description:
### Impact

A remotely exploitable vulnerability bypassing authentication for accessing the Supervisor API through Home Assistant has been discovered.

This impacts all Home Assistant installation types that use the Supervisor 2023.03.2 or older.

- Home Assistant OS
- Home Assistant Supervised

Other installation types, like Home Assistant Container (for example Docker), or Home Assistant Core manually in a Python environment, are not affected.

### Patches

The issue has been mitigated and closed in Supervisor version 2023.03.3, which has been rolled out to all affected installations via the auto-update feature of the Supervisor. This rollout has been completed at the time of publication of this advisory.

Home Assistant Core 2023.3.2 included mitigation for this vulnerability. Upgrading to at least that version is thus advised.

### Workarounds

In case one is not able to upgrade the Home Assistant Supervisor or the Home Assistant Core application at this time, it is advised to not expose your Home Assistant instance to the internet.

### Credits

The security issue was found by [Joseph Surin](https://jsur.in) from [elttam](https://www.elttam.com/). Many thanks for bringing this to [our attention](https://www.home-assistant.io/security).

### References

- https://www.home-assistant.io/blog/2023/03/08/supervisor-security-disclosure/
- https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2023-27482


### Edit history

- Adjusted Home Assistant Core version to 2023.3.2
- Adjusted Home Assistant Supervisor version to 2023.03.3

- Fix IndexError on out-of-range heater levels in Tesla Fleet ([@sebr] - [#178049]) ([tesla_fleet docs])

- Bump arcam-fmj to 3.0.1 ([@elupus] - [#185887]) ([arcam_fmj docs]) (dependency)

- Redact schedule coordinates in Teslemetry and Tesla Fleet diagnostics ([@Bre77] - [#185905]) ([teslemetry docs]) ([tesla_fleet docs])

- Prevent WiiM browse failures from marking devices unavailable ([@Linkplay2020] - [#185926]) ([wiim docs])
- Fix group sensor crash when the group has no members ([@joostlek] - [#185931]) ([group docs])
- Do not cut off KNX SQLite telegram store initialization with a timeout ([@farmio] - [#185940]) ([knx docs])
- Bump nyt_games to 1.0.1 ([@joostlek] - [#185968]) ([nyt_games docs]) (dependency)
- Gate Nanoleaf event listener on supports_events ([@loebi-ch] - [#185977]) ([nanoleaf docs])
- Fix MQTT device triggers and tags firing twice after reload ([@klejejs] - [#185998]) ([mqtt docs])
- Fix FRITZ!SmartHome SSDP host selection ([@mib1185] - [#186029]) ([fritzbox docs])
- switch Broadlink to broadlink-async (fixes #184800, replaces #184806) ([@DAB-LABS] - [#186053]) ([broadlink docs])
- Fix weatherflow last_reset updating on every device report ([@jeeftor] - [#186141]) ([weatherflow docs])
- Bump weatherflow4py to 1.5.12 ([@jeeftor] - [#186142]) ([weatherflow_cloud docs]) (dependency)
- Bump intellifire4py to 4.5.6 ([@jeeftor] - [#186143]) ([intellifire docs]) (dependency)
- Fix scrape subentry reconfigure flow not finishing ([@joostlek] - [#186144]) ([scrape docs])
- pin pycares to 5.0.1 ([@aclerici38] - [#186164])
- Allow a list of states for state conditions with a duration ([@emontnemery] - [#186165])
- Bump airthings-ble to 1.3.1 ([@LaStrada] - [#186387]) ([airthings_ble docs]) (dependency)
- Guard owner and existing credentials in auth provider create command ([@zweckj] - [#186398]) ([config docs])
- Fetch missing Renault vehicle details ([@epenet] - [#186402]) ([renault docs])
- Fix Discogs random record sensor when release has no format description ([@cerealkiller57540] - [#186405]) ([discogs docs])
- Fix permissions validation for ProxmoxVE ([@CoMPaTech] - [#186420]) ([proxmoxve docs])
- Hide MELCloud Home swing modes on units without vanes ([@erwindouna] - [#186468]) ([melcloud_home docs])
- Fix modbus reload without YAML config ([@joyjit] - [#186554]) ([modbus docs])
- Revoke refresh tokens when removing a user ([@frenck] - [#186558])
- Redact credentials and host in SFR Box diagnostics ([@epenet] - [#186668]) ([sfr_box docs])
- Fix SolarEdge module statistics sum resetting after a gap ([@tronikos] - [#186753]) ([solaredge docs])
- Bump deebot-client to 18.7.0 ([@edenhaus] - [#186779]) ([ecovacs docs]) (dependency)
- Redact identifying data in NRGkick diagnostics ([@andijakl] - [#186781]) ([nrgkick docs])
- Persist Ecovacs account credentials to avoid device verification ([@erwindouna] - [#186796]) ([ecovacs docs])
- Update frontend to 20260930.4 ([@bramkragten] - [#186813]) ([frontend docs]) (dependency)
- Fix Fritz setup failing when UPnP info lacks NewEnable key ([@mib1185] - [#186896]) ([fritz docs])
- Bump aiomelcloudhome to 0.3.0 ([@erwindouna] - [#185769]) ([melcloud_home docs]) (dependency)
- Pin pypasser below 1.0.0 ([@erwindouna] - [#186527])

body.name: 2026.10.0b4
body.body:

- Accept Matrix room IDs without a server name (@frenck - #184556)

- Fix Teslemetry vehicle flow abort when no vehicle supports Bluetooth (@frenck - #184521)

body.body:
Beta release notes can be found here: https://rc.home-assistant.io/latest-release-notes

Please note that these release notes are a work in progress. 👷‍♀️ We will be completing them over the next couple of days. Not all features might be final yet, and some features _**may not** make it into the final release_.

---

**Want to help test the beta?** Awesome! ❤️ We have documented how you [can join our beta channel and install the beta here](https://www.home-assistant.io/common-tasks/os/#running-a-beta-version).

While running the beta, we highly recommend joining our _#beta_ channel on the [Home Assistant Discord chat](https://www.home-assistant.io/join-chat)! 💬 Most developers and beta testers are in this channel during the beta period to share experiences, ideas, and iterate over new features, fine-tuning them before the final release. It's a really fun place to hang out. 😎

**Reporting issues**: As this is a beta test, you might encounter unexpected behavior or issues. 🐞 We use the GitHub issue tracker to track beta issues. You can find our issue trackers and the reported issues during beta here:

- [Report(ed) beta **dashboards/UI/frontend** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/frontend/milestone/149)
- [Report(ed) beta **integrations/automations/backend/core** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/milestone/836)
- [Report(ed) beta **documentation** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io/milestone/156)

🙏 When reporting issues, **make sure to mention the exact beta version you are running** in the issue description. This will help us identify and track the issue correctly. Read more about [reporting issues here](https://www.home-assistant.io/help/reporting_issues/).

Beta release notes can be found here: https://rc.home-assistant.io/latest-release-notes

Please note that these release notes are a work in progress. 👷‍♀️ We will be completing them over the next couple of days. Not all features might be final yet, and some features _**may not** make it into the final release_.

---

**Want to help test the beta?** Awesome! ❤️ We have documented how you [can join our beta channel and install the beta here](https://www.home-assistant.io/common-tasks/os/#running-a-beta-version).

While running the beta, we highly recommend joining our _#beta_ channel on the [Home Assistant Discord chat](https://www.home-assistant.io/join-chat)! 💬 Most developers and beta testers are in this channel during the beta period to share experiences, ideas, and iterate over new features, fine-tuning them before the final release. It's a really fun place to hang out. 😎

**Reporting issues**: As this is a beta test, you might encounter unexpected behavior or issues. 🐞 We use the GitHub issue tracker to track beta issues. You can find our issue trackers and the reported issues during beta here:

- [Report(ed) beta **dashboards/UI/frontend** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/frontend/milestone/148)
- [Report(ed) beta **integrations/automations/backend/core** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/milestone/830)
- [Report(ed) beta **documentation** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io/milestone/154)

🙏 When reporting issues, **make sure to mention the exact beta version you are running** in the issue description. This will help us identify and track the issue correctly. Read more about [reporting issues here](https://www.home-assistant.io/help/reporting_issues/).

Beta release notes can be found here: https://rc.home-assistant.io/latest-release-notes

Please note that these release notes are a work in progress. 👷‍♀️ We will be completing them over the next couple of days. Not all features might be final yet, and some features _**may not** make it into the final release_.

---

**Want to help test the beta?** Awesome! ❤️ We have documented how you [can join our beta channel and install the beta here](https://www.home-assistant.io/common-tasks/os/#running-a-beta-version).

While running the beta, we highly recommend joining our _#beta_ channel on the [Home Assistant Discord chat](https://www.home-assistant.io/join-chat)! 💬 Most developers and beta testers are in this channel during the beta period to share experiences, ideas, and iterate over new features, fine-tuning them before the final release. It's a really fun place to hang out. 😎

**Reporting issues**: As this is a beta test, you might encounter unexpected behavior or issues. 🐞 We use the GitHub issue tracker to track beta issues. You can find our issue trackers and the reported issues during beta here:

- [Report(ed) beta **dashboards/UI/frontend** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/frontend/milestone/146)
- [Report(ed) beta **integrations/automations/backend/core** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/milestone/825)
- [Report(ed) beta **documentation** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io/milestone/153)

🙏 When reporting issues, **make sure to mention the exact beta version you are running** in the issue description. This will help us identify and track the issue correctly. Read more about [reporting issues here](https://www.home-assistant.io/help/reporting_issues/).

Beta release notes can be found here: https://rc.home-assistant.io/latest-release-notes

Please note that these release notes are a work in progress. 👷‍♀️ We will be completing them over the next couple of days. Not all features might be final yet, and some features _**may not** make it into the final release_.

---

**Want to help test the beta?** Awesome! ❤️ We have documented how you [can join our beta channel and install the beta here](https://www.home-assistant.io/common-tasks/os/#running-a-beta-version).

While running the beta, we highly recommend joining our _#beta_ channel on the [Home Assistant Discord chat](https://www.home-assistant.io/join-chat)! 💬 Most developers and beta testers are in this channel during the beta period to share experiences, ideas, and iterate over new features, fine-tuning them before the final release. It's a really fun place to hang out. 😎

**Reporting issues**: As this is a beta test, you might encounter unexpected behavior or issues. 🐞 We use the GitHub issue tracker to track beta issues. You can find our issue trackers and the reported issues during beta here:

- [Report(ed) beta **dashboards/UI/frontend** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/frontend/milestone/145)
- [Report(ed) beta **integrations/automations/backend/core** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/milestone/819)
- [Report(ed) beta **documentation** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io/milestone/152)

🙏 When reporting issues, **make sure to mention the exact beta version you are running** in the issue description. This will help us identify and track the issue correctly. Read more about [reporting issues here](https://www.home-assistant.io/help/reporting_issues/).

Beta release notes can be found here: https://rc.home-assistant.io/latest-release-notes

Please note that these release notes are a work in progress. 👷‍♀️ We will be completing them over the next couple of days. Not all features might be final yet, and some features _**may not** make it into the final release_.

---

**Want to help test the beta?** Awesome! ❤️ We have documented how you [can join our beta channel and install the beta here](https://www.home-assistant.io/common-tasks/os/#running-a-beta-version).

While running the beta, we highly recommend joining our _#beta_ channel on the [Home Assistant Discord chat](https://www.home-assistant.io/join-chat)! 💬 Most developers and beta testers are in this channel during the beta period to share experiences, ideas, and iterate over new features, fine-tuning them before the final release. It's a really fun place to hang out. 😎

**Reporting issues**: As this is a beta test, you might encounter unexpected behavior or issues. 🐞 We use the GitHub issue tracker to track beta issues. You can find our issue trackers and the reported issues during beta here:

- [Report(ed) beta **dashboards/UI/frontend** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/frontend/milestone/144)
- [Report(ed) beta **integrations/automations/backend/core** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/milestone/813)
- [Report(ed) beta **documentation** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io/milestone/151)

🙏 When reporting issues, **make sure to mention the exact beta version you are running** in the issue description. This will help us identify and track the issue correctly. Read more about [reporting issues here](https://www.home-assistant.io/help/reporting_issues/).

Beta release notes can be found here: https://rc.home-assistant.io/latest-release-notes

Please note that these release notes are a work in progress. 👷‍♀️ We will be completing them over the next couple of days. Not all features might be final yet, and some features _**may not** make it into the final release_.

---

**Want to help test the beta?** Awesome! ❤️ We have documented how you [can join our beta channel and install the beta here](https://www.home-assistant.io/common-tasks/os/#running-a-beta-version).

While running the beta, we highly recommend joining our _#beta_ channel on the [Home Assistant Discord chat](https://www.home-assistant.io/join-chat)! 💬 Most developers and beta testers are in this channel during the beta period to share experiences, ideas, and iterate over new features, fine-tuning them before the final release. It's a really fun place to hang out. 😎

**Reporting issues**: As this is a beta test, you might encounter unexpected behavior or issues. 🐞 We use the GitHub issue tracker to track beta issues. You can find our issue trackers and the reported issues during beta here:

- [Report(ed) beta **dashboards/UI/frontend** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/frontend/milestone/143)
- [Report(ed) beta **integrations/automations/backend/core** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/milestone/807)
- [Report(ed) beta **documentation** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io/milestone/150)

🙏 When reporting issues, **make sure to mention the exact beta version you are running** in the issue description. This will help us identify and track the issue correctly. Read more about [reporting issues here](https://www.home-assistant.io/help/reporting_issues/).

Please note that these release notes are a work in progress. 👷‍♀️ We will be completing them over the next couple of days. Not all features might be final yet, and some features _**may not** make it into the final release_.

---

**Want to help test the beta?** Awesome! ❤️ We have documented how you [can join our beta channel and install the beta here](https://www.home-assistant.io/common-tasks/os/#running-a-beta-version).

While running the beta, we highly recommend joining our _#beta_ channel on the [Home Assistant Discord chat](https://www.home-assistant.io/join-chat)! 💬 Most developers and beta testers are in this channel during the beta period to share experiences, ideas, and iterate over new features, fine-tuning them before the final release. It's a really fun place to hang out. 😎

**Reporting issues**: As this is a beta test, you might encounter unexpected behavior or issues. 🐞 We use the GitHub issue tracker to track beta issues. You can find our issue trackers and the reported issues during beta here:

- [Report(ed) beta **dashboards/UI/frontend** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/frontend/milestone/142)

- [Report(ed) beta **documentation** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io/milestone/149)

🙏 When reporting issues, **make sure to mention the exact beta version you are running** in the issue description. This will help us identify and track the issue correctly. Read more about [reporting issues here](https://www.home-assistant.io/help/reporting_issues/).

body.body:
Beta release notes can be found here: https://rc.home-assistant.io/latest-release-notes

Please note that these release notes are a work in progress. 👷‍♀️ We will be completing them over the next couple of days. Not all features might be final yet, and some features _**may not** make it into the final release_.

---

**Want to help test the beta?** Awesome! ❤️ We have documented how you [can join our beta channel and install the beta here](https://www.home-assistant.io/common-tasks/os/#running-a-beta-version).

While running the beta, we highly recommend joining our _#beta_ channel on the [Home Assistant Discord chat](https://www.home-assistant.io/join-chat)! 💬 Most developers and beta testers are in this channel during the beta period to share experiences, ideas, and iterate over new features, fine-tuning them before the final release. It's a really fun place to hang out. 😎

**Reporting issues**: As this is a beta test, you might encounter unexpected behavior or issues. 🐞 We use the GitHub issue tracker to track beta issues. You can find our issue trackers and the reported issues during beta here:

- [Report(ed) beta **dashboards/UI/frontend** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/frontend/milestone/141)
- [Report(ed) beta **integrations/automations/backend/core** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/milestone/795)
- [Report(ed) beta **documentation** issues](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io/milestone/148)

🙏 When reporting issues, **make sure to mention the exact beta version you are running** in the issue description. This will help us identify and track the issue correctly. Read more about [reporting issues here](https://www.home-assistant.io/help/reporting_issues/).
